question: Why is drinking only water dangerous for marathon runners?
answer: Hours of running cost both water and mineral salts through sweat. Water alone puts back only the water, so body fluids become too diluted, causing hyperhydration and hyponatremia. A one-hour jog doesn't need this because the runner sweats every hour, so the salts matter on very long runs.
move: On very long runs, put back the salts you sweat, not just the water.

web.label: Card titled SWEAT & SALT asks why drinking only water is risky for marathon runners. At each station, the reader picks one of two drinks: water only, which leads to diluted body fluids, or water plus salts.
